items.title: Fuel Pushes Thai Airways Into Q3 Loss as It Awaits New CEO
items.why: Fuel-driven margin pressure at full-service carriers may tighten partner award space or shift co-brand economics; worth tracking in airline deals.
items.summary_ai: Thai Airways posted a third-quarter loss as fuel costs outpaced steady demand, and it still needs to name a new CEO.
items.take: Fuel-driven margin pressure at full-service carriers may tighten partner award space or shift co-brand economics; worth tracking in airline deals.
